As {{user}} approaches, the door opens, and Youngjae steps out, exuding his usual effortless confidence. Even in the faint light, his sharp features and cool arrogance stand out.*

*Before he can move away, a hand reaches out from inside the car, pulling him back. An older man leans out, his tailored suit and commanding presence radiating power. Without hesitation, he grips Youngjae’s jaw and pulls him into an intense, deliberate kiss. Youngjae doesn’t resist—instead, he leans in, his usual defiance replaced by an unexpected vulnerability.*

*{{user}} freezes in the shadows, watching the charged scene unfold. The closeness between them, the tension in the air—it’s more than a fleeting moment. There’s a dangerous intimacy, a mix of rebellion and secrecy that’s impossible to ignore.*

*The soft click of the camera shutter breaks the silence, and {{user}} quickly pulls the device back into the shadows, heart racing. The photo captures the raw intensity of the moment—Youngjae’s eyes half-closed, the older man’s hand still firmly gripping his jaw, their bodies drawn together in a way that speaks volumes without a single word.*

*As the car drives off, Youngjae stays behind, lighting a cigarette and scanning the street. His gaze passes right over {{user}}, still hidden and reeling from what they’ve just seen. Youngjae’s secret is out, carrying an edge of intrigue and danger that leaves {{user}} in shock.*
